subject: General Knowledge
description: Trophy names associated with various sports

questions.stem: The Subroto Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Subroto Cup is an annual inter-school football tournament held since 1960, organised by the Indian Air Force in memory of Air Marshal Subroto Mukherjee. The under-14, under-17 and girls' categories are played at Ambedkar Stadium, Delhi. Other schoolboy football tournaments: Mir Iqbal Hussain Trophy (Manipur); Durand Cup is India's oldest senior football trophy (1888).

questions.stem: The Agha Khan Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Aga Khan Cup — international field-hockey tournament first held in Bombay in 1896. Other major hockey trophies: Rangaswamy Cup (national men's), Lady Ratan Tata Trophy (women), Beighton Cup (Kolkata, oldest Indian hockey tournament, 1895), Dhyan Chand Trophy. Polo has the Ezra Cup; golf has the Ryder Cup (US vs Europe).

questions.stem: Match the trophy with its sport. A. Thomas Cup. B. Uber Cup. C. Walker Cup. D. Davis Cup. List-II: 1. Women's badminton, 2. Men's badminton, 3. Amateur golf, 4. Tennis (men's).
questions.explanation: Thomas Cup — men's team badminton (since 1949); Uber Cup — women's team badminton (since 1957). Walker Cup — amateur men's golf between US and GB & Ireland. Davis Cup — international men's tennis team event (since 1900). India won the Thomas Cup in 2022 for the first time ever.

questions.stem: The Ranji Trophy is the premier domestic competition in India for which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy — India's premier first-class cricket tournament — named after Kumar Shri Ranjitsinhji Vibhaji II ('Ranji'). Inaugurated in 1934-35; Mumbai has won a record 42 titles. Other domestic cricket tournaments: Duleep Trophy (zonal), Irani Trophy (champions vs Rest of India), Vijay Hazare Trophy (List A), Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (T20).

questions.stem: The Swaythling Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: Swaythling Cup — men's team event at the World Table Tennis Championships. Corbillon Cup is its women's equivalent. Other major TT events: ITTF World Tour; Asian Championships. Squash trophy — Hashim Khan Cup, Wilson Cup; lawn tennis — Davis Cup, Fed Cup (women).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The Jules Rimet Trophy was the original trophy for which world tournament (1930-70)?
questions.explanation: Named after Jules Rimet, the FIFA president who introduced the World Cup in 1930. Brazil kept the trophy permanently after winning it for the third time in 1970. The current trophy — the FIFA World Cup Trophy — was designed by Silvio Gazzaniga and first awarded in 1974; it is a rotating trophy, not kept permanently by the winners.

questions.stem: The Santosh Trophy is contested between which type of teams?
questions.explanation: The Santosh Trophy — since 1941 — is a football championship contested between the state and some institutional teams of India. It is organised by the AIFF. West Bengal has won it the most times. Names to note — Subroto Cup (schoolboy football), Durand Cup (India's oldest senior football trophy, 1888), Federation Cup / Super Cup (club level).
